title: WISDOM Project - XII. Clump properties and turbulence regulated by clump-clump collisions in the dwarf galaxy NGC 404
question: What are the properties of multiple-scale molecular structures (clumps and clouds) in the dwarf galaxy NGC 404, and how are their properties and gas turbulence regulated by clump-clump collisions?

data.sensitivity: 1.13 mJy beam^-1 per 2 km s^-1 channel (13.1 K)

what.value: Total CO(1-0) flux detected by BIMA of 67.4 Jy km s^-1

evidence.quote: The total CO(1-0) flux detected by BIMA is $67.4$ Jy km s$^{-1}$ (cite: taylor2015).
Comparing our CO(2-1) integrated intensity to that in CO(1-0) by (cite: taylor2015), we obtain a CO(2-1)/CO(1-0) line ratio of $\approx0.78$ in temperature units

what.value: Stellar mass model (stellar mass volume density rho_* and surface density Sigma_*,disc)

evidence.quote: where $\rho_\ast\equiv \rho_\ast(R)$ is the stellar mass volume density at each galactocentric radius, here taken from the stellar mass model presented in (cite: nguyen2017) and (cite: davis2020).

evidence.loc: Effect of stellar feedback on turbulence
evidence.quote: The stellar mass surface density is taken from the stellar mass model presented in (cite: nguyen2017) and (cite: davis2020).

what.value: Circular velocity curve, SMBH mass, and disc orientation (PA and inclination) from gas dynamical model

evidence.quote: We adopt the circular velocity curve of (cite: davis2020), derived by creating a gas dynamical model using the Kinematic Molecular Simulation (KinMS) package of (cite: davis2013).

recipe.goal: Create zeroth-moment integrated intensity map and estimate total molecular gas mass
recipe.method: Smooth-masking moment technique: convolve cube spatially with a Gaussian of beam width, Hanning-smooth in velocity, clip at 0.3 sigma_rms, integrate, and compare to BIMA CO(1-0) flux
assumptions: CO(2-1)/CO(1-0) line ratio = 0.78 in temperature units; X_CO = 2 x 10^20 cm^-2 (K km s^-1)^-1

recipe.goal: Identify hierarchy of molecular structures (leaves/clumps, branches, trunks/clouds) and measure their physical properties
recipe.method: Create 3D mask with CPROPSTOO, decompose hierarchy into leaves, branches, and trunks with ASTRODENDRO, and compute extrapolated and beam-deconvolved properties with modified CPROPSTOO
key_parameters: CPROPSTOO mask: peak T_b > 3 sigma_rms (~39 K), expanded to neighbouring pixels with T_b > 1.5 sigma_rms (~20 K), minimum island diameter ~ 3 pc (~100 spaxels)
ASTRODENDRO: min_value = 1.5 sigma_rms (~20 K), min_delta = 1.5 sigma_rms (~20 K), min_area = min_npix = 6
assumptions: eta = 1.91 for radius R_c; CO(2-1)/CO(1-0) = 0.78; X_CO = 2 x 10^20 cm^-2 (K km s^-1)^-1 (including helium); PA = 1 deg and i = 9.3 deg for R_gal; D = 3.06 Mpc

recipe.goal: Fit clump mass distribution functions, size-linewidth relations, mass-size relations, and virial parameters across galactic regions
recipe.method: Divide structures into central region (R_gal <= 15 pc) and molecular ring (15 < R_gal <= 50 pc); fit broken power-laws to differential mass functions, power-laws to cumulative mass functions, size-linewidth, mass-size, and virial parameter-mass relations; compute virial parameters and self-gravitating gas fractions
key_parameters: M_comp = 1.8 x 10^3 M_sun; turnover mass ~ 4000 M_sun; alpha_vir,crit = 2
assumptions: Virial mass M_vir,c = 5 sigma_obs,los^2 R_c / G

recipe.goal: Construct analytical clump-clump collision model and compare with radially-binned galaxy and clump properties
recipe.method: Compute radial profiles of Sigma_gas,disc, sigma_gas,disc, Oort's A, Omega, kappa, Q, Jeans and Toomre scales in 2 pc annuli; compare analytical collision predictions (t_coll, lambda_coll, M_c,coll, R_c,coll, energy injection rate, size-linewidth, mass-size) with observed properties and VLA SFR upper limits
key_parameters: Radial bin size = 2 pc, PA = 1 deg, i = 9.3 deg
assumptions: Infinitely thin 2D disc, circular orbits, spherical galaxy mass distribution for tidal radius, completely inelastic equal-mass clump collisions, Kolmogorov turbulence spectrum

score_reason: ALMA project codes and the full machine-readable catalog of 3626 identified structures are provided, and ASTRODENDRO/CPROPSTOO parameters and analytical equations are explicitly stated, though the modified CPROPSTOO code and external kinematic/stellar profiles must be obtained from companion papers.
rediscovery_reason: Public ALMA data and complete parameterization of the dendrogram decomposition, statistical scaling relations, and parameter-free analytical model allow direct quantitative reproduction of all main numeric results.
